lines.text: Many learners say: Let me to help you.
Let me goes straight to the verb.

data.why: Let me goes straight to the verb.

native.hook: let me 后面不加 to！
native.tip: 很多同学习惯在动词前加 to，但 let me 后面直接接动词原形，不加 to。

en.tip: After let me, go straight to the verb.
